messages:
sara_pm: Heads-up — Customer Atlas (enterprise pilot) is asking for 7y immutable audit retention, BYOK-compatible exports, and a SOC2-ready evidence bundle. They want a go/no-go by EOW for our Q3 launch. Can we outline launch gates + rough effort?

michael_eng: quick thought — 7y retention across multitenant hosted infra raises storage/cost and immutability needs. We need: retention tiers, tamper-evident checksums, SHA256 signing on export, and a KMS handshake flow.

anita_security: +1. For SOC2 evidence we also need access logs for key custody ops, proofs of export, and an auditable chain-of-custody for each evidence bundle. Need to specify retention policy metadata per-tenant.

dave_ps: From PS/customer side: Atlas wants the ability to request on-demand export of a tenant's audit for legal holds, plus an automated monthly snapshot export into their S3 (customer-managed). They expect envelope encryption with their keys.

sara_pm: Can we map that to concrete launch gates? My draft gates: 1) schema and retention policy spec signed off, 2) BYOK export prototype working end-to-end, 3) SOC2 evidence template + test export, 4) cost model + quota limits, 5) Ops runbook + oncall playbook. Thoughts?

michael_eng: Technically: prototype work items — (A) audit-log schema v1 with event types and tenant metadata, (B) immutable append-only store with retention TTL + legal-hold override, (C) export pipeline that wraps, signs, and uploads to customer S3. Rough SRE effort ~3 sprint-weeks for v1.

anita_security: Add: key expiry/rotation handling for BYOK exports, HSM/KMS audit trails, and an integrity verification tool that can validate exported bundles. Also define acceptable SLA for export completion (e.g., 99% within 6h for <500GB).

kyle_legal: Legal: need explicit contract language for BYOK escrow/rotation, and constraints on forensic access. Also confirm data residency commitments (Atlas requires EU-only storage).

dave_ps: Atlas will accept an initial phasing: 1) 1y retention + BYOK export, 2) extend to 7y with cold-tier archival and immutability. They want canary pilot with 3 customers first.

michael_eng: Implementation risk notes: cold-tier archive likely cheaper in Glacier-like storage. We must ensure immutability (object lock or WORM pattern) and preserve proof-of-existence hashes in our hot index for verification. Export path must never send raw key material to us.

sara_pm: OK — adjust launch gates: Gate A: spec approved (schema, retention tiers, export API shape, residency), Gate B: BYOK export POC (tenant handshake + upload) + security review, Gate C: SOC2 evidence generation + legal signoff, Gate D: cost/quotas + pilot signups, Gate E: ops/playbook + rollback.

anita_security: Proposed acceptance criteria for each gate: Gate A: spec doc + example JSON schema + test vector; Gate B: successful end-to-end export to a tenant S3 using customer KMS, automated verification CI; Gate C: evidence bundle includes chain-of-custody file, signed manifests, and automated audit report; Gate D: cost per TB and throttles documented; Gate E: runbook tested in staging with simulated outages.

michael_eng: Can we get a minimal sample schema in this thread for comment? E.g.:

```json
{
  "event_time": "2026-03-18T17:00:00Z",
  "tenant_id": "atlas-123",
  "event_type": "MODEL_INVOCATION",
  "request_id": "req_abc",
  "payload_hash": "sha256:...",
  "log_level": "INFO",
  "retention_tier": "hot|cold|archive",
  "legal_hold": false
}
```

anita_security: Good start. Add `evidence_id`, `signature` (detached), `kms_key_id_ref` (no raw key), and `region_tag`. Also include `export_manifest` when shipped.

dave_ps: I'll prep Atlas pilot acceptance criteria from customer side and share by Thursday.

ops-bot: Deploy check: audit-log-schema-v1 spec doc updated at https://redwood.internal/docs/audit-schema-v1 (CI: passed). :white_check_mark:

sara_pm: Next steps I propose: 1) michael to own prototype work items & ETA (sprint plan by EOD), 2) anita to own security acceptance & evidence template, 3) kyle to draft contract clauses, 4) dave to manage Atlas pilot coordination. I'll coordinate gating calendar and stakeholder signoffs.

michael_eng: I'll post a short sprint plan here by 18:00 PT.

anita_security: I'll draft the evidence manifest template and a short verification script example.

kyle_legal: I'll circulate draft contract language to product and legal ops.

dave_ps: Allocated to me — will confirm Atlas pilot customers and timeline.

sara_pm: Thanks — marking as action-items and will create the formal milestone in the roadmap. :thumbsup:
